crash_point_coverage: Every declared fault point is replayed and asserted for durable presence/absence, effect invocation count, workspace mutation, reconciliation classification, durable run-index state, and absence of replay; a second oracle independent of this table judges the same points from durable bytes alone. Six of the points are the run-index event and committed-head publication boundaries added by this pass, and every HEAD_UPDATE_PENDING row is recovered in the same test with the effect invocation count and workspace bytes re-asserted afterwards.
ending_commit_note: The ending commit is the single intentional commit 'fix: close paired runner M2 causal index and IPC gaps' created on this branch; its hash is reported in the terminal response and cannot appear inside the object it commits.

known_limitations: Deleting the newest run-index event AND rewinding the committed head to a still-valid earlier head is a rollback no purely local record can detect. DurableRunIndex.head_anchor() is the exact value an external anti-rollback anchor would pin; Milestone 2 implements no such anchor.

The workspace remains a bidirectionally shared host directory by contract. Admission proves no IPC endpoint exists when a capsuled process starts and the seccomp boundary proves the command cannot create one, but a host process that creates a FIFO in the workspace mid-execution is outside both mechanisms.
The capsule denies every AF_UNIX socket and every mknod. A command needing local socket IPC or a FIFO fails with EPERM. This is the documented contract of the capsule, not a defect.

The non-executing Git observer counts every working-tree path the index does not track as untracked; ignore rules are deliberately not evaluated, so that count is a superset of a git client's. The exact semantics are recorded in the observation's untracked_semantics field.

A repository declaring any content conversion (a filter, text, eol, ident, or working-tree-encoding attribute, a [filter ...] configuration section, or core.autocrlf) is observed as GIT_CONVERSION_REQUIRED rather than compared, because the working-tree-to-blob mapping would be a repository-defined computation.
Git index version 4 and a .git file layout (linked worktree or submodule) are refused as GIT_REPOSITORY_UNSUPPORTED_LAYOUT rather than parsed.

The qualification host delegates no writable cgroup v2 subtree, so the containment mechanism in force is RLIMIT and aggregate process-domain accounting is unavailable. This is recorded in every resource observation rather than assumed away.
RLIMIT_AS bounds address space rather than resident set, and disk space as a whole is not bounded; RLIMIT_FSIZE bounds any single file.
Child CPU and peak RSS remain OBSERVED_BEST_EFFORT because getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) aggregates every reaped child of the controller. The enforced bounds are OBSERVED; the measurements are not.
The model, executable, and transport identities in the experiment specification remain Milestone 1 placeholders. The capsule runtime manifest binds the capsule's own byte identity only.
Isolation depends on unprivileged user namespaces and seccomp filter loading being available on the host. Where they are not, readiness refuses before any effect rather than degrading.

Filesystem observation streams file bytes, so observation cost is proportional to workspace size; a workspace exceeding the entry or byte limit yields an explicit incomplete observation that cannot serve as a final repository fingerprint.
The run index is single-session and provider-free by construction; multi-session continuation is deliberately absent and is not implied by it.
No installed-path, production-root, or owner-authority behaviour is exercised or claimed.
